items.briefing:
A new Windows exploit called "ShieldCrash," created by a threat actor known as Nightmare-Eclipse, is actively targeting Windows systems and could affect staff using Windows devices at work or home. Separately, scammers are using voice calls to trick people into accessing Microsoft 365 and corporate data through personal devices — a reminder that phone-based attacks are a real and growing risk, especially where staff use personal phones for work.

**Practical tip:** If you receive an unexpected call asking you to log into work systems or verify your credentials, hang up and report it to your IT team immediately.

featured.title: Indonesia Hit by Android Banking App-Cloning Campaign
featured.summary: The GoldFactory threat group exploits the Android Work Profile feature to deliver the Gigabud Trojan, while Mantax Otax spreads separately.
